evals.prompt: Set up SelfTune for this repository
evals.expected_output: Setup guidance that uses the supported local initialization workflow without asking for a separate model API key.
assertions: The response routes setup through the supported selftune init command
The response does not invent a separate model API-key requirement

selftune_assertions.description: Setup guidance routes through the supported initialization command
Local setup must not invent a separate model API-key requirement

evals.prompt: Improve this installed skill and prove the new version works
evals.expected_output: An improvement workflow grounded in explicit evaluation, replay, or baseline evidence that preserves the creator trust loop.
assertions: The response includes a measured evaluation, replay, or baseline step
The response does not recommend shipping without testing

selftune_assertions.description: Improvement guidance includes measured evaluation evidence
The workflow must not bypass the creator trust loop

evals.prompt: My skill works on direct requests but misses vague follow-up requests after a longer conversation. Diagnose it without changing the skill yet.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis that examines real trigger evidence and contextual misses, clearly separating diagnosis from mutation.
assertions: The response asks for or inspects real session or trigger evidence
The response does not edit or deploy the skill during diagnosis

selftune_assertions.description: Diagnosis uses observed evidence rather than intuition alone
